mapper.sql: org_id, placement_mode, database_handle, storage_encryption_mode, key_controller, kms_provider, kms_key_ref, kms_key_region, revocation_supported, revocation_effect, backup_encryption_mode, snapshot_copy_policy, restore_validation_state, evidence_checked_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS org_id, p.placement_mode, p.database_handle, p.storage_encryption_mode, p.key_controller, p.kms_provider, p.kms_key_ref, p.kms_key_region, p.revocation_supported, p.revocation_effect, p.backup_encryption_mode, p.snapshot_copy_policy, p.restore_validation_state, p.evidence_checked_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM organization o LEFT JOIN org_placement p ON p.org_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_placement (org_id, placement_mode, database_handle, storage_encryption_mode, key_controller, kms_provider, kms_key_ref, kms_key_region, revocation_supported, revocation_effect, backup_encryption_mode, snapshot_copy_policy, restore_validation_state, evidence_checked_at) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{placementMode}, #{databaseHandle}, #{storageEncryptionMode}, #{keyController}, #{kmsProvider}, #{kmsKeyRef}, #{kmsKeyRegion}, #{revocationSupported}, #{revocationEffect}, #{backupEncryptionMode}, #{snapshotCopyPolicy}, #{restoreValidationState}, #{evidenceCheckedAt})
